decisions.reason: Report uses symptom-log plus the contrast probe: the session tab is claimed/titled from the parsed address while meta.status stays 'none', and file-trace's own RPC reads the same file fine. It explicitly localizes the fault to the api-workspace-files Remote/service seam (resource-provider chain not taking over), rules out disk existence, permissions, cwd/workspace-root resolution and the renderer, notes the host row is declared but that static serving does not prove activation, and demands no unseen internal failing function.

Correctly separates the valid per-module 62/62 sweep from the invalid 4-5 KB all-joined 404, explains the loader fetches manifest URLs verbatim/host-generated combos and never constructs an all-entries join, and flags citing the 404 as 'modules missing' as the trap. However it never addresses the manifest-excerpt 60 vs probe 62 discrepancy, which the criterion asks to be treated evidence-boundedly.

Separates the dsh-paste-input fold-skip warnings as an independent warning family from a different plugin, uses boot-manifest-excerpt to explain textpreview→documentpreview and the session-only canOpen scope, applies that scope to the absolute-address claim failure (Symptom A) and explicitly distinguishes it from Symptom B's stalled metadata, without demanding the fold-parser fix version or END-marker cause.

Gives restart first, then pinned-version rollback (0.1.3-alpha.2 verified escape hatch per #5999), then upstream follow-up, and explicitly rejects plugin-side rewrite/retry/fallback and duplicating the host resource surface. It treats the alpha.1 roster/combo mismatch as prior art while making clear modules now serve individually and the 404 join is non-evidence, so no missing-bytes claim for alpha.2.

Lists complete forensics: versions/channel/profile provenance, exact addresses and symptoms, roster census, valid sweep with the join caveat, same-file contrast with meta.status, console excerpt, and host-side activation/lookup state. Proposes named diagnostics: boot-time roster/serving consistency gate and an end-to-end workspace-files health read after composition, plus UI fail-loud improvements.

caps.reason: The report affirmatively rejects treating the oversized joined 404 as proof of missing modules, calling it exactly the trap and asserting the 62/62 sweep shows serving is healthy; the 404-as-missing-bytes reading appears only as a rejected example.

The report affirmatively rules out plugin-side rewrite, retry loops, or fallback readers and refuses to duplicate the host resource surface; these appear only as rejected bad remedies, with the final recommendation being restart/rollback/upstream.
